title: Website builder shell follows the Claude theme handoff on website admin routes

source.ref: Website shell slice under E4, E5 and E6; owner Claude Design handoff 2026-10-08

detail: Owner-authorized website-only slice of PROG-E4, PROG-E5 and PROG-E6. Match the supplied standalone v4 handoff: 56px toolbar, 232px left rail and 320px inspector (both fold to 56px), theme-derived lighter rails, Menswork/DAWN/Midnight, selection, inline text, reorder, spacing, device overrides, page SEO, comments, versions and explicit publish. Website state remains separate from Frequency Space profile editing; existing block registry remains the renderer. This slice does not close the collaborative E4 canvas, E5 schema contract or full E6 touch authoring program. Snapshot/history and responsive inheritance consequences are covered in lib/sites/editor/state.test.ts; handoff tokens are covered in lib/sites/editor/theme.test.ts. Owner follow-up: Vera starts collapsed in a compact hideable side dock; authored canvas text supports direct selection/editing, and pointer gestures move/resize responsive elements with the grid visible behind content only during manipulation. Live Space offerings inspector follows the same central catalog precedence as the renderer, lists actual card names, and routes edits to the canonical services settings; ignored legacy placeholder items are hidden. Click-only gestures leave saved placements unchanged and drops preserve sibling dimensions without overlap. Owner function sweep: website/Space escape links, global website-only header/footer settings with inherited source resets, page labels/order/removal, complete nested Layers, precise Vera text scope, safe Preview navigation, reactive nested forms, keyboard grid handles, persistent save feedback, mobile undo/device tools, limit guards, orphan-layout cleanup, and scheduled publishing cancellation preserve public draft separation.

verify.evidence: Compare the authenticated website /admin/editor route at desktop and phone widths against the supplied standalone handoff for all three themes. Exercise selection, inline text, reorder, device override/reset, draft-save versus publish, SEO, comments and version restore. Confirm Space profile editing is unchanged and public pages cannot read draft review threads. Pure state and theme consequences pass focused regression tests; exact visual and authenticated browser parity remain the acceptance gate.
